title: Beauty Color
summary: Site and ecommerce for curly, coily and wavy hair care, with a routine quiz, product grid and PDP in the brand's voice.
challenge: Beauty Color speaks to people hunting the right formula for their own hair. The old site stacked a catalog. What was missing was a path: learn your type, understand free-from, reach the product without getting lost.
solution: We designed home, about, product listing and PDP, a recommendation quiz and FAQ. The violet, magenta and yellow palette carries the brand; the product fold and quiz guide the purchase.

story.approachLead: Textured hair at the center. The site keeps up.
story.approach: We started from SoulPower and the Beauty Color line: bold type, graphic waves and a palette that doesn't apologize. Each screen has a job: home sells the brand, products sell the line, the quiz cuts doubt.

deliverables.title: Home and about
deliverables.body: Hero with a hero product, shelf, quiz, influencers, free-from and blog. The brand shows up before the cart.

deliverables.title: Products
deliverables.body: Listing with filters and cards; PDP with gallery, benefits and free-from. The product fold was built for scroll and discovery.

deliverables.title: Routine quiz
deliverables.body: Short questions into a result with recommended products and a buy CTA.

story.quote: The right formula starts with understanding the hair.

about.title: For coily, curly and wavy hair.
about.body: Beauty Color stands for care and clean formulas. The site has to feel like the product: color, texture, trust. About holds the story; home already delivers the line.

system.title: Home sells the brand in folds.
system.body: Hero, product carousel, quiz, influencers, free-from, blog and social. Each block has an exit: see the line, take the quiz, follow on Instagram.

applications.title: The product list is the fold that moves.
applications.body: Filters, cards and CTAs on a long grid. In the case, the screen arrives and the fold scrolls up. The catalog becomes narrative, not a static grid.
points: Grid with image, name, price and buy
Buy banner at the end of the list

process.title: Quiz: doubt becomes a recommendation.
process.body: Three questions, loading and result. The user leaves with a suggested kit and a clear path to the shop.

palette.title: Violet, magenta and yellow.
palette.body: The dark brand ground, magenta CTA and yellow support carry SoulPower. Cream holds product folds and reading.

type.title: Bold display, clean UI type.
type.body: Wide titles in the brand voice. Readable sans for price, filters and forms.
